tool.name: sincei scScoreFeatures
tool.description: aggregate region-level signal into gene or feature scores
tool.command: #if $features.is_of_type('gtf'): ln -s '$features' features.gtf && #set $features_file = 'features.gtf' #else: ln -s '$features' features.bed && #set $features_file = 'features.bed' #end if scScoreFeatures --input '$input' --features '$features_file' --outFile scores.h5ad --overlapPolicy '$overlapPolicy' --maxRegion $maxRegion $centerScores $normalizeGeneLengths #if str($bedScoreFilter).strip(): --bedScoreFilter $bedScoreFilter #end if @THREADS@ && mv scores.h5ad '$scores'

param.label: Features (BED/GTF)
param.help: Genes or other features to compute scores for.

param.label: Partial overlap policy
param.help: How to treat regions of the count matrix that only partially overlap a feature.
param.option: partial: count proportionally to the overlap
all: count all reads of the overlapping region
none: only count regions fully inside the feature

param.label: Maximum flanking region (kb)
param.help: Maximum distance up- and downstream of each feature to consider.

param.label: Center and scale scores
param.help: Scale scores to zero mean and unit variance.

param.label: BED score filter
param.help: For BED features with a score (column 5): a single upper threshold, or a 'min max' range, of the scores to keep.

validator.message: One or two numbers separated by a space

tool.help:
**What it does**
`scScoreFeatures` sums the signal of a binned count matrix (e.g. from `scCountReads bins`) over genes or other features from a BED/GTF file. The result is a cells x features score matrix, for example gene activity scores from scATAC or scChIP data.
-----
**Inputs**
- An AnnData (`h5ad`) count matrix with genomic regions as variables. - A BED or GTF file of features.
**Outputs**
- An AnnData (`h5ad`) object with one score per cell and feature. @HELP_FOOTER@
